capabilities: s3-list | Send an S3 ListObjects or ListObjectsV2 request on the bucket and get back the object keys under the service's prefix, proxied through the gateway with that prefix stripped. Listing only; it returns no object bytes and there is no write path.
description: Customer supplies the upstream bucket, endpoint, and credentials through their own secret store; the gateway proxies S3 requests to the customer's storage. Region defaults to us-east-1 (via `${ customer_secrets.S3_REGION ?? us-east-1 }`) if the customer hasn't set the secret.
name: s3-byoe

payout_price.description: No platform commission — customer uses own bucket
